In crates/harness/tests/session.rs, reuse the agy stand-in for the prompt and open and closed response rows, keeping the timestamp changes and the assertions for reopening, brief matching, and ignoring the full transcript.
answer: Made each: briefed uses Line::flag(-i); ToolCall.args is Value with serde default (Null), matched directly; recorded_turn uses find_map over USER_INPUT rows; the agy turn test now starts from write_session and appends rows, keeping reopening, brief-prefix, other-brief and transcript_full assertions (and adds a GENERIC tool-result row that must leave the turn open).
